Permanent delete inside Edit, separated and confirmed, feels safe. The title opening the original page in a new tab is right, and the bulk actions cover what I need.

One bulk-selection safety rule is important: changing the view, search, or tag filters should clear the current selection. I don’t want previously selected but now-hidden links affected by a later bulk action.

For preview images, keep the main list image-free; the thumbnails make it feel busier and can leave awkward blank spaces when images fail. Capture the image and show it in the save-review and Edit views instead.

With those two adjustments included, fold these behaviors into the settled scope and begin the real build.
